text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
For this Osaka Hai, it's gotta be Air 
Groove! She's in a whole different league 
from the others, a whole different league!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I want to bathe in the 'Empress's' 
brilliance again today...! Do your best, 
Air Groove!"

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, the crowd is all over Air Groove as 
expected... Dober-chan, don't let the 
atmosphere get to you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do you notice... the atmosphere in the 
stands? Air Groove-senpai's popularity 
really is incredible, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, this is where I currently 
stand. Far, far away from any "new glory."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why...! In this race, I 
will chase down Air Groove-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have to get even a little bit closer to 
my “ideal”...!
choice_data_list: Make sure you don't get too worked up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I know. Senpai isn't the kind of 
opponent you can beat with feelings 
alone."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Senpai isn't an opponent you can 
beat with willpower alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Senpai— I'm looking forward to working 
with you today...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I expect you to run with all your soul.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I have to chase after it... The ideal 
Senpai envisions...!!)
